settings.heading: Let’s talk.
settings.text: Questions about an order, a size, or a design? Send a note and include your order number if you have one.

settings.question: Where can I find my order number?
settings.answer: Your order number is included in the confirmation email sent after checkout.

settings.question: Can I change an order after placing it?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. Because production begins after ordering, changes may not be possible once your item enters production.

settings.heading: Quick answers.
settings.text: A couple of things that may help right away.
